emergence.summary: MEFV encodes pyrin (marenostrin), an innate-immune sensor that nucleates the PYRIN inflammasome -- a SECOND, distinct inflammasome from the NLRP3 inflammasome of CAPS. On activation pyrin recruits the adaptor ASC and pro-caspase-1, and active caspase-1 matures pro-IL-1beta to its secreted form. FMF alleles -- clustered in the C-terminal B30.2/SPRY domain (M694V, M680I, V726A, M694I) -- are FUNCTIONALLY gain-of-function: the mutant pyrin escapes its normal RhoA-PKN regulatory brake and assembles the inflammasome at a lowered threshold, so IL-1beta is OVER-produced and the inflammatory drive is pushed UP. (FMF is classically inherited autosomal-recessive / gene-dose-dependent, yet the protein-level lesion is an over-active sensor.) The phenotype is recurrent, self-limited attacks of fever with SEROSITIS (peritonitis, pleuritis), synovitis and an erysipelas-like erythema, with AA amyloidosis as the feared long-term complication. This is read as an over-driven ACCELERATOR of IL-1beta output on the inflammasome / autoinflammatory axis -- the SECOND inflammasome SENSOR the kit reads (after NLRP3) but the FIRST on the PYRIN inflammasome -- so the corrective direction is to RESTRAIN it. The kit re-derives the iconic approved lever: colchicine, the FMF first-line, which neutrophils concentrate and where it depolymerises microtubules and thereby suppresses pyrin-inflammasome assembly and the downstream IL-1beta drive -- a CYTOSKELETAL / microtubule mechanism NOT used in CAPS or DIRA. For colchicine-resistant disease it re-derives IL-1 blockade (canakinumab, FDA-approved for colchicine-resistant FMF; anakinra). The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only (firewall); the B30.2-domain missense lesions are outside the promoter firewall and every magnitude is held [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: pyrin-inflammasome IL-1beta drive (MEFV-pyrin over-activation -> caspase-1 -> IL-1beta over-production -> recurrent serosal/synovial autoinflammation) -- a second inflammasome SENSOR on the IL-1 axis

per_gene.note: MEFV (Mediterranean fever; pyrin / marenostrin) encodes the sensor that nucleates the PYRIN inflammasome; via ASC it activates caspase-1, which matures pro-IL-1beta -- the driver of the autoinflammatory response. FMF alleles in the C-terminal B30.2/SPRY domain are functionally GAIN-of-function: the mutant pyrin escapes RhoA-PKN-dependent inhibitory phosphorylation and assembles/fires at a lowered threshold -> IL-1beta is over-produced -> the inflammatory drive is pushed UP. As an over-driven ACCELERATOR of IL-1beta output the pathological axis goes UP and the corrective levers LOWER it. Classically autosomal-recessive / gene-dose-dependent, 16p13.3 (OMIM 608107 gene). NCBI official symbol MEFV. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the activating B30.2-domain missense lesions are outside the promoter firewall.

levers.push_direction: suppress microtubule-dependent pyrin-inflammasome assembly in neutrophils -> less caspase-1 activation -> less IL-1beta produced -> lower the inflammatory drive (the first-line, upstream lever; also prevents AA amyloidosis)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of inflammasome suppression / attack control not derived from sequence
levers.src: Goldfinger 1972 NEJM 287:1302 (colchicine prevents FMF attacks); Zemer 1986 NEJM 314:1001 (colchicine prevents amyloidosis); Park 2016 Nat Immunol 17:914 (colchicine/microtubule-pyrin)

levers.push_direction: neutralise the over-produced IL-1beta -> lower the inflammasome-driven inflammatory drive (for colchicine-resistant FMF)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of IL-1beta neutralisation / inflammation control not derived from sequence

falsifiers.claim: MEFV functional GOF (over-active pyrin inflammasome) raises IL-1beta over-production (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an FMF MEFV allele that LOWERED pyrin-inflammasome assembly / caspase-1 activation / IL-1beta secretion would refute the over-driven-accelerator direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: ASC-speck / pyroptosome formation, caspase-1 activation and mature IL-1beta release from MEFV-mutant vs wild-type monocytes / neutrophils

falsifiers.claim: restraining the pyrin inflammasome / IL-1 (colchicine or IL-1 blockade) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if colchicine, IL-1beta neutralisation or IL-1-receptor blockade RAISED or failed to lower attack frequency and inflammatory markers, the restrain lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: attack frequency, CRP / SAA inflammatory markers and amyloidosis progression in response to colchicine or an IL-1 blocker in FMF

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
